confirmation.heading: The following will be deleted permanently:
confirmation.prompt: To continue, type {word} and press Enter.
options.ask_role:
What do we install or remove?
{listing}
options.bad_choice: could not understand the choice: {answer!r}. Run again with --role.
options.description: Install and remove Quoroom on one machine
options.no_roles: this build has no roles: an installer without roles has nothing to do.
options.role_missing: --role is not given and there is no interactive input: pass --role explicitly.
participant.agentschat_missing: agentschat is not installed: the kit files and {manifest} are left in place, remove them by hand.
participant.all_removed: The kit and the package are removed.
participant.broker_retry: Run the same command again after the server is started: the check will run to the end, and what is installed stays in place.
participant.broker_silent: the broker does not answer at {url}: {error}
participant.chatlogin_next: In an agent session, run /chatlogin and name the session.
participant.cli_choice_unclear: could not understand the CLI choice: {answer!r}. Run again with --claude or --opencode.
participant.consequence_room_safe: The conversation in the room on the server stays in place.
participant.consequence_sessions: the session files will be gone together with their tokens: the only way back into the room is a new login through agentschat login.
participant.dsh_manifest_kept: the DSH profile manifest {path} is left in place: it does not read as JSON, remove the plugin entries by hand.
participant.dsh_plugin_failed: the dsh CLI failed to add the plugin: {detail}
participant.dsh_profile_missing: the DSH profile manifest {path} is missing or does not read as JSON: create the profile in DeepSeek Harness first and run this again.
participant.dsh_prune_failed: pnpm could not remove the plugin from the DSH profile: remove the leftovers in {path} by hand.
participant.dsh_skill_edited: the DSH skill {target} already exists and differs from the Quoroom kit: it was written by someone else. Remove it by hand (or keep yours) and run this again.
participant.dsh_skill_missing: the kit has no DSH chatlogin skill in {variant}: the kit is incomplete, the installation cannot continue.
participant.help_dsh: install the DeepSeek Harness participant (skill and plugin)
participant.kept_not_session: left in place, not a session file: {path}
participant.kit_conflict_files: the install is cancelled and nothing was written. These files already exist, differ from the Quoroom kit and were not installed by it: {files}
participant.kit_conflict_force: To overwrite them, run the same command again with --force: agentschat install --force
participant.kit_edited_kept: Kit for {cli}: files edited by hand are left as they are: {files}. The next agentschat install will overwrite them - that is how it works.
participant.kit_files_orphaned: The kit files call agentschat, which is gone: delete them or install the participant again.
participant.language_not_learned: The room language was not learned from {url}: agentschat speaks English until the broker answers a command of the client.
participant.left_heading: Not everything was removed, what is left in the system:
participant.left_kit_edited: kit files for {cli} edited by hand, left by uninstall
participant.left_kit_not_asked: kit for {cli} was not removed: no run flag named it
participant.left_kit_not_removed: the kit was not removed: agentschat was not found, so its files and records remain
participant.manifest_empty: {manifest} is still there, but it has no entries: remove it by hand.
participant.manifest_kept_auto: {manifest} is kept for the reasons above: when no entries are left, agentschat uninstall will delete it itself.
participant.manifest_kept_manual: {manifest} is kept for the reasons above: delete it together with these files.
participant.no_other_files: There are no other files in the directory.
participant.package_found: the {package} package is already installed through {tool}: it may point to another copy of the repository or may not be installed as editable. I will not reinstall it and will not create an installer record.
participant.package_found_record: The installer record names {recorded}: it is left as it is.
participant.package_in_use: the {package} package is left in place: the kit for {clis} uses it
participant.package_stale_record: the record said {tool} installed the package, but it is not in the system: removing the record, deleting nothing.
participant.package_unrecorded: the {package} package is not recorded as the installer's: leaving it in the system.
participant.path_missing: agentschat was not found in PATH: run "{command}", open a new terminal and restart the sessions.
participant.pnpm_failed: pnpm failed to add the plugin: {detail}
participant.pnpm_missing: pnpm is not installed: without it the plugin cannot be added to the DSH profile. Install pnpm and run this again.
participant.python_too_old: This is Python {running}, but the package needs {required} or newer (bridge/pyproject.toml, requires-python). Install a suitable Python and run this again.
participant.restart_one: Restart the open {name} sessions: running ones do not see the new kit.
participant.restart_two: Restart the open {first} and {second} sessions: running ones do not see the new kit.
participant.restart_unchanged: The kit is in place and did not change, no need to restart the sessions.
participant.session_files_kept_reinstall: Session files in {store} are left in place: after a reinstall the session will return to the room through /chatlogin.
participant.session_files_kept_relogin: Session files in {store} are left in place: you can return to the room with a new login.
participant.set_url_permanently: Set the address permanently, otherwise a new session will not see it: {command}
participant.tool_missing_linux: Neither uv nor pipx was found: without one of them the quoroom package cannot be installed. Run apt install pipx and run this again.
participant.tool_missing_windows: Neither uv nor pipx was found: without one of them the quoroom package cannot be installed. Run winget install Python.Python.3.11 astral-sh.uv FiloSottile.mkcert and run this again.
roles.default_consequence: there will be no way to restore this data.
roles.dest_not_allowed: role {role} must not set dest: the flag {flag} derives it from its name
roles.purge_step_not_destructive: purge step "{step}" of role {role} does not declare what it deletes
roles.remove_step_finds_unrecorded: removal step "{step}" of role {role} looks for unrecorded things: those are deleted only with a question, that is, in the purge
server.account_manual: The account {username} does not exist on the server, and {toml} was not created by this installer, so the installer will not register it here. Create it with {script} and run this again, or give the installer your own file.
server.admin_password_needed: The password of the human account is needed. Set the variable {variable} or run the installer in a terminal, where it asks for the password without echo.
server.admin_user_needed: A local account for the human is needed: they sign in to Element with it, and the first account on the server becomes its administrator. Run again with --admin-user <name>.
server.ask_admin_user: Name of the local account the human will sign in to Element with:
server.bot_password_refused: The saved password for {agent} did not fit the account on the server: {refused}. Reset the password in Element or delete the account, then run this again.
server.bot_password_unknown: The bot account {agent} already exists on the server, and the installer does not know its password: reset it in Element or delete the account, then run this again.
server.bots_manual: {toml} was not created by this installer, so the installer will not create the bots here. Enter the user_id, access_token and device_id of each bot into {config} yourself - register_account.py shows the values.
server.broker_not_started: The broker did not answer at {url}/status within {tries}s. See bridge/broker.log and restart the stand.
server.broker_not_stopped: The broker did not stop answering at {url}/status within {tries}s: stop it yourself with {script} and run this again.
server.broker_port_wrong: {path} sets sessionchat_port={port}, but start.sh and start.ps1 bring the broker up on {expected}, and the scripts must not be changed. Set sessionchat_port: {expected} in the configuration.
server.broker_restart: The broker already answers, and this run wrote the bot tokens: restart the stand by hand (stop and start) so that it picks up the new ones.
server.ca_root_missing: the mkcert root is missing: {bundle}. It appears when the first certificate is issued.
server.certificate_renew: To renew it: mkcert -cert-file {cert_file} -key-file {key_file} {server}, then docker compose -f "{compose}" restart caddy.
server.close_manual_edit: {name} was not created by this installer, so the installer will not close registration here. Set allow_registration = false in {toml} and run docker compose -f "{compose}" restart continuwuity.
server.close_manual_restart: {toml} already has allow_registration = false, but the server does not close registration: restart it with docker compose -f "{compose}" restart continuwuity.
server.closure_unconfirmed: Registration is closed in the file, but the server did not confirm it: a trial registration with a deliberately wrong token was not refused with 403. Check that the container restarted with the new file, with the command docker compose -f "{compose}" restart continuwuity.
server.compose_missing_linux: Install the plugin: apt install docker-compose-v2.
server.compose_missing_windows: Docker Desktop ships compose v2; update Docker Desktop.
server.config_conflicts: {path}: could not write {names}. Either the file already holds another value, or it is written in a form the installer does not edit (a line in curly braces, a quoted key). Enter the values yourself and run this again.
server.consequence_room_stays: the conversation in the room on the server will stay in place
server.consequence_volumes: the compose volumes with the room data will be gone: the conversation will be deleted for good
server.daemon_stopped_linux: Start dockerd. If you are not in the docker group, run usermod -aG docker $USER, log in again and run this again.
server.daemon_stopped_windows: Start Docker Desktop and run this again.
server.docker_missing_linux: Install Docker: apt install docker.io, start dockerd and run this again.
server.docker_missing_windows: Install Docker Desktop: winget install Docker.DockerDesktop, start it and run this again.
server.docker_unavailable: docker is not available, the stand was not taken down: {error}
server.env_server_name_differs: {path}: line {number} sets SERVER_NAME={given}, but the stack is set up for {server}. Edit it by hand: the homeserver name is baked into the Caddyfile and the Element config.
server.env_server_name_missing: {path}: there is no SERVER_NAME line, add it by hand.
server.help_admin_user: the human's local account in Element
server.homeserver_url_wrong: {path} sets homeserver_url={url}, but the stack is up at {address}. Set homeserver_url: {address}.
server.hosts_instruction_linux: Add the line "127.0.0.1 {server}" to /etc/hosts (as root): the name {server} must resolve to the loopback address, otherwise the stand on the host will answer instead of the stack.
server.hosts_instruction_windows: Add the line "127.0.0.1 {server}" to C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts (as administrator): the name {server} must resolve to the loopback address, otherwise the stand on the host will answer instead of the stack.
server.hosts_line_kept: The line "127.0.0.1 {server}" in {where} is left in place: remove it if the machine no longer needs the name.
server.images_kept: The stand images are left in place: {images}. They are shared with other projects, so the installer does not delete them.
server.issued_token_missing: The server did not print its registration token. Get it yourself with the command docker compose -f "{compose}" logs continuwuity and register the account with register_account.py.
server.left_foreign: left in place: the stand was built by hand, the installer did not record them
server.left_heading: Not everything was removed, left in the system:
server.left_records: installer records are left in place: --purge removes them
server.left_state: the broker state is left in place: the broker creates these files, the installer does not record them and deletes them only next to a recorded continuwuity.toml
server.left_volumes_mine: the compose volumes with the server data are left in place: --purge removes them
server.left_volumes_theirs: the stand volumes are not recorded by the installer, so they are left in place
server.left_volumes_unreadable: the stand volumes are left in place: the Docker daemon does not answer, there is nothing to read them with.
server.logs_kept: the installer logs are left in place: the removal task card does not count them as part of the cleanup
server.mkcert_failed: mkcert did not issue the certificate: {detail}
server.mkcert_missing_linux: Install mkcert: apt install mkcert libnss3-tools (project: github.com/FiloSottile/mkcert).
server.mkcert_root_kept: The mkcert root is left in place: {root}. It is shared by all projects on the machine, so the installer does not touch it.
server.mkcert_root_manual: You can remove it by hand ({command}), but that will break all other mkcert certificates and leave files in {root}.
server.mounted_kept: {step}: {target} is left in place: the stand containers are up, and they need this file: it is mounted into them or defines the compose project.
server.registration_closed: The server does not accept registrations (HTTP 403): registration is closed. Set allow_registration = true in {toml} and run docker compose -f "{compose}" restart continuwuity.
server.removed: The stand is stopped, the server installation is removed.
server.report_became_admin: The first account became the server administrator and received an invitation to the admin room.
server.report_next: Next, call /chatlogin in each CLI session. To stop everything: {script}
server.room_alias_without_server: The room alias {room!r} must name the server: an alias is always written as #name:{server}.
server.room_bad_start: The room identifier must start with ! or #, not with {room!r}.
server.room_differs: {config} already holds the room {stored}, and this run was given {asked}. The first one is kept: the installer does not overwrite a recorded value. Change room_id in {path} and run this again.
server.room_has_space: The room identifier must not contain whitespace: {room!r}.
server.room_instruction: Create a room in Element under your account and invite {who} to it. The broker accepts the invitation itself. Then open Room settings -> Advanced -> Internal room ID and pass the value to the installer through --room-id as it is: it starts with !, and the domain, if there is one, must be {server}.
server.room_is_example: The room identifier is still the example from {example}: {room!r}.
server.room_missing: The room identifier is not given.
server.room_no_name: The room identifier {room!r} has no name after ! or #.
server.room_other_server: The room identifier {room!r} points to the server {domain!r}, but the stand runs on {server}.
server.server_silent: {server} did not answer within {seconds}s: {reason}. See docker compose -f "{compose}" logs continuwuity.
server.stand_left_up: The Docker daemon does not answer, the stand containers are left running.
server.stand_remains: The stand containers are left in place: the Docker daemon did not answer, there was nothing to take them down with.
server.stand_removed: The stand containers and its network are taken down although they were not recorded: they are not data, start creates and brings them up.
server.stand_unseen: The Docker daemon does not answer, the stand containers were not checked: there is nothing to take them down and make sure with, and the broker is already silent.
server.toml_line_empty: {path}: line {number} ({setting}) is empty, fill it in by hand.
server.toml_line_missing: {path}: there is no {setting} line, add it by hand.
server.toml_token_is_example: {path}: registration_token is still the example from {example}, replace it with your own.
server.trust_instruction: The browser and the broker must trust the certificate of {server}. Run as administrator: {command}.
server.trust_retry: After that, run the same command again.
server.venv_in_use: bridge/.venv cannot be removed: the installer is running on its own interpreter {python}. Leave this environment and run the same command again.
server.volume_left: {failure}. The volume is left in the system.
server.volumes_kept: the stand volumes are not deleted ({ids}): the Docker daemon does not answer and the containers are still running, so the files mounted into them are left in place too. Start Docker and run the same command again: the purge will finish the rest.
step.install_kit: Refresh the kit for the agent CLIs
step.learn_room_language: Ask the broker for the room language
step.remove_kit: Remove the kit for the agent CLIs
step.stop_stand: Stop the broker and the stand
steps.cancelled: Cancelled by the user, nothing was changed.
steps.failure_saved: The changes of this run are kept:
steps.kept_as_record: {step}: left in place as an installer record: {ids}
steps.resume: Run the same command again: it will continue from where it stopped.
steps.stopped_for_human: Stopped at step "{step}": a person has to do this. {resume}
